summary.en: See and add events in the Calendar app
summary.zh: 查看、新增「行事曆」App 裡的活動

label.en: Add and change your calendar events, each change asked of you first
label.zh: 新增、修改行事曆活動，每一筆都先問你

name.en: A local server on this Mac (beta)
name.zh: 這台 Mac 上的本機伺服器（測試版）

blurb.en: A small server on this Mac reads Calendar through macOS itself; nothing leaves the computer. Every change it would make is asked of you first. The first time, macOS asks whether ShellBot may use Calendar.
blurb.zh: 這台 Mac 上的小伺服器透過 macOS 本身讀行事曆，資料不離開電腦。它要改的每一筆都會先問你。第一次用時，macOS 會問要不要讓 ShellBot 使用行事曆。

note.en: ShellBot adds it for you in the step "Add it to Claude".
note.zh: ShellBot 在「加進 Claude」那一步幫你加。

note.en: Each change it would make in Calendar is put to you first in the program's confirmation form; a program that cannot show that form can only read. Not tried with this program.
note.zh: 它要改行事曆的每一筆都會先在程式的確認表單問你；顯示不了那個表單的程式就只能讀。還沒用這個程式試過。

note.en: Each change it would make in Calendar is put to you first in the program's confirmation form; a program that cannot show that form can only read. Not tried with this program.
note.zh: 它要改行事曆的每一筆都會先在程式的確認表單問你；顯示不了那個表單的程式就只能讀。還沒用這個程式試過。

note.en: Each change it would make in Calendar is put to you first in the program's confirmation form; a program that cannot show that form can only read. Not tried with this program.
note.zh: 它要改行事曆的每一筆都會先在程式的確認表單問你；顯示不了那個表單的程式就只能讀。還沒用這個程式試過。

note.zh: 它要改行事曆的每一筆都會先在程式的確認表單問你；顯示不了那個表單的程式就只能讀。還沒用這個程式試過。

how.en: The server runs on Node.js. ShellBot looks for it on this Mac.
how.zh: 伺服器要用 Node.js 跑。ShellBot 會在這台 Mac 上找。

how.en: If it is missing or too old, install the LTS version from nodejs.org, then press "I did it".
how.zh: 沒有或太舊的話，到 nodejs.org 裝 LTS 版，再按「我做好了」。

text.en: Node.js {version} is installed
text.zh: 已安裝 Node.js {version}

text.en: Node.js {version} is too old: 20 or newer is needed
text.zh: Node.js {version} 太舊了：要 20 以上

text.en: Node.js was not found on this Mac
text.zh: 這台 Mac 上找不到 Node.js

how.en: Press the button: ShellBot adds one entry of its own, shellbot-apple-events, to Claude's settings. It runs mcp-server-apple-events version 1.6.2, which asks you before every change.
how.zh: 按下面的按鈕：ShellBot 在 Claude 的設定裡加一個它自己的項目 shellbot-apple-events。它跑的是 mcp-server-apple-events 1.6.2 版，每次要改東西前都會先問你。

how.en: The same server serves Reminders and Calendar, so Claude can see Reminders through it too; macOS still asks for each separately.
how.zh: 同一個伺服器管提醒事項和行事曆，所以 Claude 也能透過它看到提醒事項；macOS 還是會分開問。

text.en: Added to Claude
text.zh: 已加進 Claude

text.en: Added to Claude (replacing ShellBot's earlier entry)
text.zh: 已加進 Claude（換掉 ShellBot 之前加的那一項）

text.en: Claude refused the change
text.zh: Claude 沒有接受這個設定

note.en: Not tried on a real Mac yet: whether macOS asks ShellBot for access the first time.
note.zh: 還沒在真的 Mac 上試過：macOS 第一次會不會問 ShellBot 要不要給權限。

title.en: Test it, and allow it in macOS
title.zh: 測試，並在 macOS 允許

intro.en: ShellBot opens a temporary Claude tab and asks it to list your calendars: it only counts. The first time, macOS asks whether ShellBot may use Calendar: choose Allow (OK). If nothing asks, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars and turn ShellBot on.
intro.zh: ShellBot 會開一個臨時的 Claude 分頁，請它列出行事曆：只數筆數。第一次 macOS 會問要不要讓 ShellBot 使用行事曆：選「好」（允許）。沒有跳出來的話，打開「系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性 → 行事曆」，把 ShellBot 打開。

text.en: Opening a temporary Claude tab…
text.zh: 正在開臨時的 Claude 分頁…

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

text.en: Waiting for the tab to be ready…
text.zh: 等分頁準備好…

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

text.en: Asking it for one small lookup in Calendar…
text.zh: 請它在 行事曆 做一次小查詢…

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

text.en: Calendar is answering…
text.zh: 行事曆 回應中…

next.en: This usually takes about a minute. Only the test tab sees what comes back.
next.zh: 通常約一分鐘。結果只有測試分頁看得到。

text.en: The test tab is asking for your OK
text.zh: 測試分頁在等你按允許

next.en: It wants to use a Calendar tool, and Claude asks before it does. Open the test conversation and choose Allow. The test goes on by itself afterwards.
next.zh: 它要用 行事曆 的工具，Claude 會先問你。打開測試對話，選允許。之後測試會自己繼續。

text.en: It works! Calendar is connected.
text.zh: 通了！行事曆 已連結。

next.en: The temporary test tab used the local Calendar server. ShellBot does not read, keep or log what came back: it is only in the test tab's own conversation. A Claude tab that was already open before you connected Calendar may need to be reopened before it sees it (not confirmed).
next.zh: 臨時的測試分頁用了本機行事曆伺服器。回來的內容 ShellBot 不讀、不存、不記錄：只在測試分頁自己的對話裡。連結之前就開著的 Claude 分頁，可能要重開才看得到 行事曆（尚未證實）。

text.en: This one does not count. The test tab said it worked but never called a Calendar tool.
text.zh: 這次不算：測試分頁說成功了，卻沒有叫過任何 行事曆 工具。

next.en: Press "Test again". If it happens again, open the test conversation and see what the tab did.
next.zh: 按「重新測試」。再發生的話，打開測試對話看看分頁做了什麼。

text.en: It took too long. After 3 minutes the test tab had not finished.
text.zh: 等太久了：3 分鐘了，測試分頁還沒做完。

next.en: Most likely it is waiting for you. Open the test conversation: Claude may be asking you to allow a tool, or sitting on a sign-in screen.
next.zh: 最可能是在等你。打開測試對話看看：Claude 可能在問你要不要允許某個工具，或停在登入畫面。

text.en: No clear answer. The test tab used Calendar, but it did not end with a clear result line.
text.zh: 沒有明確的結果：測試分頁用了 行事曆，但最後沒有留下明確的結果那一行。

next.en: Open the test conversation to see how it ended, then press "Test again".
next.zh: 打開測試對話看它怎麼結束的，再按「重新測試」。

text.en: The test tab did not get ready. It never reached its prompt, so nothing was asked.
text.zh: 測試分頁沒有準備好：它一直沒有走到可以輸入的畫面，所以什麼都沒問。

next.en: Most likely Claude is not signed in. Open the test conversation: if it shows a sign-in screen, sign in there, then test again.
next.zh: 最可能是 Claude 還沒登入。打開測試對話：如果停在登入畫面，在那裡登入，再測一次。

text.en: The test tab was closed before it finished.
text.zh: 測試分頁沒做完就被關掉了。

text.en: Could not open the test tab.
text.zh: 開不了測試分頁。

next.en: Open a Claude tab yourself from the + button. If that works, press "Test again".
next.zh: 自己用 + 按鈕開一個 Claude 分頁。開得起來的話，再按「重新測試」。

text.en: Calendar answered with an error: most likely macOS did not allow it.
text.zh: 行事曆回了錯誤：最可能是 macOS 沒有允許。

next.en: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars, turn ShellBot on (Full access for Calendar), then test again. If ShellBot is not in the list, macOS never asked: that is the part of this beta not tried yet; press "I'm stuck".
next.zh: 打開「系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性 → 行事曆」，把 ShellBot 打開（行事曆要「完整取用權」），再測一次。清單裡沒有 ShellBot 的話，表示 macOS 沒問過：這正是測試版還沒試過的部分，請按「卡住了」。

text.en: Not yet. The test tab did not find the Calendar tools.
text.zh: 還沒通：測試分頁沒有找到行事曆的工具。

next.en: Go back to step 2 and add it to Claude again. Next: type /mcp in the test tab and see whether shellbot-apple-events failed to start (Node.js, or the first download).
next.zh: 回到第 2 步再加一次。其次：在測試分頁打 /mcp，看 shellbot-apple-events 是不是啟動失敗（Node.js，或第一次下載）。

a.en: Everything up to the test runs as on any other service, but nobody has yet clicked through macOS's question on a real Mac with ShellBot. If macOS never asks, ShellBot does not show up under Privacy & Security and the test cannot pass.
a.zh: 測試之前的步驟都跟其他服務一樣，但還沒有人在真的 Mac 上用 ShellBot 點過 macOS 的那個問題。如果 macOS 一直不問，「隱私權與安全性」裡不會出現 ShellBot，測試就過不了。

q.en: Why can Claude also see Reminders?
q.zh: 為什麼 Claude 也看得到提醒事項？

a.en: One server serves Reminders and Calendar, and there is no switch to serve only one. Connecting either adds the same entry; it is removed when neither is connected any more.
a.zh: 同一個伺服器同時管提醒事項和行事曆，沒有只開一個的選項。連結任何一個都加同一個項目；兩個都中斷之後才會移掉。

q.en: Can it change things without asking?
q.zh: 它會不會沒問就改東西？

a.en: It is started with --require-write-confirmation: every change is put to you first in the program's confirmation form, and a program that cannot show that form can only read. Deleting or inviting can notify other people, so read the form before you allow it.
a.zh: 它是用 --require-write-confirmation 啟動的：每次要改東西都會先在程式的確認表單問你，顯示不了表單的程式只能讀。刪除或邀請可能會通知別人，所以允許前請看清楚表單。
